caseName: State Corp. Commission of Kansas v. United States
caseNameFull: STATE CORPORATION COMMISSION OF KANSAS v. UNITED STATES
attorneys: Byron M. Gray and Robert Londerholm for appellant., Solicitor General Cox, Assistant Attorney General Orrick, Robert B. Hummel, Robert W. Ginnane and Stanton P. Sender for the United States et al., Harvey Huston and Roth A. Gatewood for railroad appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motions to affirm are granted and the judgment is affirmed.

Mr. Justice Douglas is of the opinion that probable jurisdiction should be noted.
